title: WaSP: Wasserstein Data Synthesis Pipeline for Solver-Free Operator Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.07646v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neural operators offer fast surrogates for solving PDEs, but training them typically requires expensive input-solution pairs. Two solver-free alternatives include physics-informed learning and training on manufactured data. Physics-informed learning approximates solutions by minimizing PDE residuals. While the residual norm must be strong enough to control solution error, stronger norms increase mini-batch variance and hinder optimization. Manufactured data constructs input-solution pairs for learning by applying the PDE operator to artificial solutions. However, the resulting training distribution can be mutually singular with the target distribution, yielding poor accuracy on the target distribution. We introduce the Wasserstein Data Synthesis Pipeline (WaSP), which trains on manufactured input-solution pairs while gradually mitigating the distribution shift. translated_title: WaSP：面向无求解器算子学习的Wasserstein数据合成流水线
translated_abstract: 神经算子为求解偏微分方程（PDE）提供了快速的代理方法，但训练它们通常需要代价高昂的“输入-解”数据对。两种无需求解器的替代方案包括物理信息学习和基于人造数据的训练。物理信息学习通过最小化PDE残差来逼近解，虽然残差范数必须足够强才能控制解的误差，但更强的范数会增加小批量的方差并阻碍优化。人造数据方法则是通过将PDE算子作用于人工构造的解来构建用于学习的“输入-解”数据对，然而由此得到的训练分布可能与目标分布相互奇异，导致在目标分布上的精度很差。我们提出了Wasserstein数据合成流水线（WaSP），它在人造的“输入-解”数据对上进行训练，同时逐步缓解分布偏移。WaSP通过将学习到的算子应用于一条路径上的输入来合成新的数据对……
tldr: 该论文提出WaSP，一种基于Wasserstein度量的数据合成流水线，通过在人造数据对上训练并逐步缓解训练分布与目标分布之间的偏移，实现了无需求解器的高效算子学习。
en_tdlr: WaSP is a Wasserstein-based data synthesis pipeline that trains neural operators on manufactured input-solution pairs while gradually mitigating distribution shift, enabling solver-free operator learning.
